originalTitle: Will the LK-99 room temp, ambient pressure superconductivity pre-print replicate before August 15, 2023?
title: LK-99 能否在最初的短期窗口得到复现？
Would LK-99 replicate in the initial short-term window?
rules: 原题截止为 2023 年 8 月中旬；平台判定 No，保留结算及停盘前的成交历史。
The original horizon is mid-August 2023; the platform resolved No and pre-close/pre-resolution trades are retained.
interpretation: 市场描述没有一套完整的复现验收清单。研究论文、市场创建者的判断与最后成交概率需要分别阅读。
The description does not provide a complete replication checklist. Papers, creator judgments and last-trade probabilities remain separate.

summary: 这是最早一轮短期复现题，平台判 No；它与“出现独立实验论文”题的预测对象不同。
This early short-window replication contract resolved No; it asks a different question from paper appearance.
checklist: 核对短期窗口，避免把之后的实验放入当时信息集。
Respect the short window and exclude later experiments from the then-available information set.
查材料、测量条件与独立复现要求。
Review material, measurements and independence requirements.
将负实验论文与未能成功复现的判定并列阅读。
Read negative experiments alongside the unsuccessful-replication outcome.

stage: 材料复现 → 导体加工 → 器件商品
impact: SuperPower 已有低温 REBCO 线材产品，说明超导产业存在制造和客户应用链条；但官网条件仍需低温。独立实验对材料前提的检验，比把既有“高温超导”产品误读成常温突破更贴近这些题目。

SuperPower demonstrates an existing cryogenic REBCO supply chain, not an ambient-temperature breakthrough. Independent material tests are more relevant to these premises than the label high-temperature.
gap: 没有资料表明该企业采用 LK-99，或其线材符合原题高于 0 °C、常压、无需主动冷却条件。论文出现、复现成功、商品销售和条件市场取消分别判断。
No cited source establishes LK-99 adoption or above-0 °C uncooled operation. Paper appearance, replication, sales and conditional cancellation remain separate outcomes.

title: 复现实验出现，不等于超导结果被复现
A replication paper can appear without replicating superconductivity
principle: 原始宣称、独立实验论文、独立成功复现和商业应用是四类事件。一篇实验论文报告未发现超导，仍可让“有没有独立实验论文”判 Yes，同时让“是否复现成功”判 No。

An original claim, an independent experimental paper, a successful replication and a commercial device are different events. A negative experimental paper can satisfy the paper-appearance contract while failing a superconductivity-replication contract.
example: 曼彻斯特相关实验未在其样品中观察到超导；中国科学院物理所相关工作检验了 Cu₂S 杂相带来的电阻突变。阅读市场时，应核对材料物相、零电阻的测量下限与磁性证据，而不是将一条电阻曲线的形状当作完整验证。

The Manchester-linked study found no superconducting signatures in its samples; the Institute of Physics study examined Cu₂S-related transitions. Market interpretation should track sample phases, resistance limits and magnetic evidence, not just the shape of a resistance curve.
